integrity: All-parameter proof uses exact roots-of-unity binomial counts and matrix decomposition. Finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Literature priority is provisional; independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-cube first-Walsh-band restriction to all points in one weight congruence class modulo three, dimensions n>=5; not higher degrees, arbitrary sampling designs, or nonlinear reconstruction.
title: Two-level spectral collapse and optimal residue selection in modulo-three Walsh sampling
